wifi_ssid: your-wifi-network-name (the isolated management SSID the nodes live on)
healthchecks_url: https://hc-ping.com/<your-check-uuid>  (master dead-man's switch; omit or leave empty to disable)
static_ip: optional; e.g. 192.168.1.3 to pin this device — omit for DHCP. Just the IP is enough (gateway defaults to <ip>.1, subnet 255.255.255.0, DNS = gateway). Override with static_gateway / static_subnet / static_dns if needed. PER-DEVICE: set at top level or in a single-node env, never a shared multi-node env.
omada_url: Settings -> Controller -> Controller URL  |  Cloud US-East: https://use1-api-omada-essential-controller.tplinkcloud.com  |  Local: https://<controller-ip>:8043
omada_controller_id: visible in the browser URL path after logging in to the Omada web UI
openapi_client_id: from GlobalView -> OpenAPI -> Client Management -> Create Client
openapi_client_secret: from GlobalView -> OpenAPI -> Client Management -> Create Client
